testCase.fullName: OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate › OAT-05/S25

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S25 「闸门生命周期：打开、每项都有证据、签字、然后才进真实 PHI；医生用的 build 连生产；之后的改动重新打开它」 Gate lifecycle: open, all items evidenced, signed off, then real PHI; physician builds on production; a later change re-opens it

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 The gate shows a clean pass before any real patient data enters the system. Dev and testing run on a separate deployment, and no real patient data exists outside production.（UAT OAT-05；TFA-92568 AC 12；TFA-94703 AC 2；TFA-94703 B5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94703 development backlog
  • T6 Retention and purge are live in production (TFA-94699), as part of the PHI gate. Behavior is tested in OAT-04; here it is a gate item only.（TFA-94059 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U2 Every AI provider in active use has a signed, coverage-confirmed BAA: confirmed and coverage-verified for that provider's service and for the account that is actually used, not assumed from the provi …（UAT OAT-05；TFA-94059 AC 1；TFA-94059 AC 2；TFA-92568 AC 8；TFA-92568 Product 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on.（UAT OAT-05；UAT 3.1；TFA-94059 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress
  • U4 The Convex plan tier is the BAA-eligible tier: the actual account plan supports the BAA, not just that a BAA document exists. …（UAT OAT-05；TFA-92568 AC 9；TFA-92568 Product 2；TFA-94703 B1；TFA-94703 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94703 development backlog

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given The OAT-05 result with its evidence, the gate record (Q13), the OAT-01 to OAT-04 and OAT-06 results, TFA-94703 L6 and L7, the builds that will reach pilot physicians (store release, TestFlight, Play internal, web host), and the production and dev deployments. …

When Walk the states. Open: any item lacks evidence. Evidence complete: every OAT-05 scenario passes (blocked ones once unblocked), including S31 (TFA-94059 AC 7, retention live in prod, per Q10); every physician-facing build points at the production deployment on the BAA team (the Convex URL baked in, read as in S01/S02); …

Then Real PHI enters only after sign-off: on production, the earliest physician account outside roundai.test and the earliest patient it created are dated after the sign-off. Every build a physician uses points at production. Dev has no real physician accounts and no patients created by one. Each trigger returns the gate to Open until that item is checked again.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 Expected 'This gate must show a clean pass before any real patient data enters the system'; TFA-92568 AC 12 ('until every item above from both lists is confirmed'); TFA-94703 AC 2 and B5 ('no real patient data outside production'). …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 DOC · 文档核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：DOC · 文档核对；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：code-review。
